english.title: Heeding the Call
english.detail:
Excuse me, friend...

It has come to my attention that Mathrengyl Bearwalker has put out word that he wishes to speak with you.  It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally.  Mathrengyl is the direct assistant to the Arch Druid himself, and is one of the most sage and august druids you'll find in Teldrassil.

He is located in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus, on the second floor of Fandral Staghelm's tree.
english.objective: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.
english.complete:
I'm glad you found your way here today, young <class>.  The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature.  Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges.  We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own.  Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.

Ready yourself!

english.title: Child of Nature
english.detail:
Greetings, young <race>. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.
english.objective: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
english.complete:
A high elf, speaking to me... in Thunder Bluff. Will wonders never cease?

Well, shaper of wind, let me join our Earthen Ring brothers and sisters in welcoming you to Azeroth. My fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.

english.title: Child of Nature
english.detail:
Greetings, young <class>. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.

english.complete:
Greetings, fellow <class>. It pleases me to meet a fellow <class> from among the Skyborne, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth.

I think you will find that my fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.

english.title: Moonglade
english.detail:
All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.

english.title: The Great Cat Spirit
english.detail:
It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid. Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.
english.objective: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
english.complete:

english.title: Call of Water
english.detail:
If there is one lesson you must learn of water, it is this: water means rebirth.

english.title: Call of Water
english.detail:
To find understanding and gain the sapta from me, you must seek out only the purest forms of water. As you fetch the samples for me, take note of your surroundings. Be aware of the creatures that rely on the water, that protect it. See how it affects forests and deserts. Witness how the very substance that sustains life will force creatures to take lives.

We shall start with a simple task: down below my hut there is a pond of the precious liquid. Fill this skin with it and return to me.
english.objective: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the watering hole below Brine's hut and return it to her in the Barrens.
english.progress:
I am just about prepared to send you on your other tasks. Have you filled the skin yet?

I know how protective the quilboar can be. Even such a small water source is a vast hoard of wealth to them. They have great feasts when even the slightest rain comes to the Barrens. Water is sacred to their kind because it is so scarce. Do you understand?
english.complete:
I thought some bloodshed might ensue if you tried to take water from the pool. It is a pity the quilboar do not realize that all living things are tied together; that their greed only perpetuates the pain and suffering of their people. How much could they accomplish if they were to put their differences aside and their clans came together.

Again, a pity, but more than likely a boon for the other races of the Barrens.

english.title: Call of Water
english.detail:
Long ago I followed some companions into the Hillsbrad Foothills. We defended ourselves from some tenacious humans who make their home there and we found ourselves in a small town the Forsaken had taken over: Tarren Mill.

It was there I found a most peculiar thing: in the center of town was a small well of fresh spring water. I'm not sure the plagued citizens of the town even realize its value--it's a small holy vestige in an unhallowed sea.

Bring me a sample of that water in this waterskin.
english.objective: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at the well in Tarren Mill and return to Brine in the Barrens.
english.progress:
The well remaining pure within the town reminds me of stories told to me when I was younger, <name>. Even in times of great pain and sorrow one can find a sliver of hope, a small symbol to rally around. The orc people see Thrall this way. He survived against great odds and rose up to lead our people through his strength and example.

I'm not sure any orc has suffered as much as he has, but at the same time, I'm not sure any orc is as strong as he is either.
english.complete:
This is good, <name>. You're dedicated to the task at hand and have the ability to seek out that which is needed.

One more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Islen will be pleased as well.

english.title: Call of Water
english.detail:
Take this waterskin and head deep into the lush forest the night elves call Ashenvale. It is to the far north of the Barrens.

Once you've entered the forest, travel west. Along the mountains that separate Stonetalon and Ashenvale, and beyond Lake Mystral, you will find a holy place: the Ruins of Stardust. At the center of the lake you will find a small fountain.

Bring me a sample of the fountain's water. It will be the final component you'll need before I send you back to Islen.
english.objective: Fill the Empty Blue Waterskin at the Ruins of Stardust in Ashenvale and return to Brine in the Barrens.
english.progress:
Do you have the water yet, <name>? Tales say the ruins were protected by large creatures of nature that do not care for visitors, but those could be myths to scare off the enemies of the night elves.

Regardless, be careful.
english.complete:
Wonderful, <name>. With all three samples gathered, I can create for you a vial of the purest water any living creature will find. It will be used in the next steps of your rite of passage.

I am pleased to count you among our kind, <name>. You do all <class> proud, and I look forward to hearing about your exploits in the future.

english.detail:
Along the coast of Silverpine, west of the Sepulcher, you will find a shrine that has become tainted by the plague. The spirits there no longer speak to our people and it will be up to you to defeat the manifestation and cleanse the pool.

Take the elemental's bracers, along with the remaining drops of Brine's potion, and place them on the brazier. The ritual should be enough to summon a pure spirit for you to communicate with.

Bring me proof the task is done, and I will reward you with your totem.

The corruption along the hills seems to have kept its distance, and besides the missing components, the brazier looks prepared for the ritual to summon a cleansed manifestation of water.

If there's one truth ye need to learn about water, it's this: water means rebirth. It carves stone, cleanses filth, and heals the weary -- but only when it's pure. Taint it, and it'll ruin all it touches.

Aye, I see it in yer eyes, <race>. You're wonderin' what kind o' soul chooses to live out here, deep in the Wetlands, with Dark Iron scum lurkin' about and nary a guard in sight. Well, we all have our reasons, love.

english.title: Call of Water
english.detail:
Ah, so ye've come seekin' the sapta, have ye? Well then, listen close, love. To find understandin' and earn the sapta, ye must seek water in its various forms. As ye gather the samples, keep yer eyes open. Watch the beasts that guard it, the land it nourishes, and how it changes lives.

We'll start simple: fill this skin at the base o' the falls, where the fresh meets the brackish. Go on now, and mind the marsh.
english.objective: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the bottom of the waterfalls below Hervdana's cave and return it to her in the Wetlands.
english.progress: I'm nearly ready to send ye off on the rest o' yer tasks. But tell me, have ye filled the skin yet? The ocean brings life, aye--but it carries sediment, minerals, and energies far different from the snowmelt and springwater of the highlands. Where sea and spring meet, there's wisdom to be found.
english.complete:
Glad ye managed to steer clear o' the Dark Iron. Shame they've crept so far north--makes ye wonder what dwarfkind could do if the clans ever stopped squabblin' and worked as one.

Still, the tides rise high when the moons are strong, and the seawater floods the marsh. It's here that we study our estuary water.

Thank ye for this sacred offering. It marks the beginning of your stage as a vessel--one who seeks the waters' wisdom.

english.title: Call of Water
english.detail:
Aye, Redridge drinks deep from Lake Everstill, but by the time the waters tumble down Stonewatch Falls, somethin' has seeped in. The murlocs down there are big, twisted brutes. Not like the ones ye find here or in the Loch. Lucky for the townsfolk they keep to the base o' the falls.

Bring a sampling to me. I've a mind to find out if it's magic, venom, or somethin' worse that's taintin' the waters near that old fort.
english.objective: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.
english.progress: The folk o' Lakeshire don't ken how good they've got it--fresh water flowin' right at their boots, keepin' their nets full, their crops green, and their coin purses jinglin'. Even when the kingdom's guard can barely spare a lad with a sword, they've got Everstill watchin' over 'em.
english.complete:
Aye, this is good water, <name>. The magic used by the shadowseers in the region must be changin' the murlocs. Nothin' but pure water, this be. Yer dedication to the task at hand and abilities to seek out that which is needed prove you're ready for the next stage of your journey.

One more sample is all I need to create the reagent needed for your sapta. Norric will be pleased as well.
